articles.title: Prime Factorization and Identifying Numbers with Limited Prime Factors
articles.summary: A coding-challenge walkthrough for determining whether a positive integer has prime factors only from 2, 3, and 5.
keyTakeaways: Reduce the input by checking divisibility by 2, 3, and 5.
A remaining quotient greater than 1 indicates a prime factor above 5.
Return a boolean indicating whether all prime factors meet the limit.
